text_block_list.text:
Having safely achieved an impressive result
at the Kikuka Sho, Agnes Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well... that wasn't as bad as I thought it'd be,
Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
That was a straightforward, earnest run.
Is she really a problem child?

Agnes Tachyon's sprint was sparking a change
in the hearts of all who watched—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha, hahahaha!
Not bad! Ah, not bad at all!"

Agnes Tachyon's expression was so brilliantly bright
that it made me instinctively flinch.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I think so too! I wish I could just cut these memories straight out of my head and preserve them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case...
we've finally made it to the starting line.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I see.
Then I must fulfill my promise."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Once things settle down, I shall visit the Trainer's office.
There is something I must discuss with you.

Her expression as she said that
was unusually serious.
